sentences.text: The Tremont Street Subway in Boston 's MBTA Subway system is the oldest subway tunnel in North America and the third oldest worldwide to exclusively use electric traction -LRB- after the City and South London Railway in 1890 , and the Budapest Metro 's Line 1 in 1896 -RRB- , opening on September 1 , 1897 .	MBTA Subway	MBTA Subway	electric traction	electric traction	City and South London Railway	City and South London Railway
It was originally built to get streetcar lines off the traffic-clogged streets , instead of as a true rapid transit line .	rapid transit	rapid transit

It now forms the central part of the Green Line , connecting Boylston Street to Park Street and Government Center stations .	Green Line	Green Line (MBTA)	Boylston Street	Boylston (MBTA station)	Park Street	Park Street (MBTA station)	Government Center	Government Center (MBTA station)	Boylston	Boylston (MBTA station)

The tunnel originally served five closely spaced stations : Boylston , Park Street , Scollay Square , Adams Square , and Haymarket , with branches to the Public Garden Portal and Pleasant Street Incline south of Boylston .	Pleasant Street Incline	Pleasant Street Incline	Park Street	Park Street (MBTA station)	Boylston	Boylston (MBTA station)	Scollay Square	Scollay Square (BERy station)	Adams Square	Adams Square (BERy station)	Haymarket	Haymarket (MBTA station)	Public Garden Portal	Green Line (MBTA)#Public Garden and Boylston Street

Park Street , Scollay Square , and Haymarket stations were altered over the next two decades as transfers were added to the Cambridge-Dorchester Subway , East Boston Tunnel , and Main Line Elevated -LRB- now part of the Red , Blue , and Orange Lines , respectively -RRB- . In 1962 , the southern portal at Pleasant Street was closed ; the following year , the northern half of the tunnel was substantially altered when Government Center and a new Boston City Hall replaced Scollay Square and Adams Square . The northbound tunnel to Haymarket station was rerouted ; the southbound tunnel is still original .	Haymarket	Haymarket (MBTA station)

Scollay Square station was rebuilt as Government Center , and Adams Square station was closed .	Government Center	Government Center (MBTA station)	Scollay Square	Scollay Square (BERy station)	Adams Square	Adams Square (BERy station)
